summary: Rejected on afternoon wording without slot gating and a Mood cost described as physical neck strain. All three cards were read; required similarity review is complete.

issues.problem: The fixed text says this afternoon, but the card has no slot or time gate. The townhouse is open through night and its away-day recipe supplies visits at noon, afternoon, evening and night. It can describe an afternoon during the night slot.
issues.fix: Use slot: afternoon for the specific scene, or remove/condition the afternoon wording and the warm sun detail for later visits.

issues.problem: Read a while deducts Mood -tiny. Its first outcome shows an aching neck and a head full of new knowledge, a physical cost and positive discovery, without a loss of spirits. The second outcome has the librarian coughing you out, but that does not show the first variant paying its Mood cost.
issues.fix: Show boredom, embarrassment or another actual Mood cost in the first variant; alternatively use a physical cost with matching prose in every variant.
